name: bolna-mcp
description: Manage Bolna voice AI agents, calls, batches, phone numbers, SIP trunks, and more from Claude.
long_description: Local MCP server wrapping the Bolna Voice AI REST API: 84 tools covering agents, call executions, batches, dispositions, phone numbers, inbound routing, SIP trunks, sub-accounts, TTS voices/providers, workflows, and documentation search. Requires a Bolna API key from your Bolna dashboard.

api_key.title: Bolna API Key
api_key.description: Your Bolna API key, from the Bolna dashboard.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List agents in the account (id, name, status, created_at). Paginated.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Full config of one agent by ID.

tools.name: create_agent
tools.description: Create a new agent. Returns its ID.

tools.name: update_agent
tools.description: Patch an existing agent's name, prompts, welcome message, webhook, or voice settings.

tools.name: delete_agent
tools.description: Permanently delete an agent. Irreversible.

tools.name: stop_agent_queued_calls
tools.description: Cancel every queued call for an agent.

tools.name: start_outbound_call
tools.description: Place a real outbound call from an agent. Spends account balance.

tools.name: stop_call
tools.description: Cancel a queued or scheduled call.

tools.name: list_agent_executions
tools.description: Call history for one agent. Paginated, defaults to the last 7 days.

tools.name: get_execution
tools.description: Full details of one call: transcript, status, cost, telephony data.

tools.name: get_execution_raw_logs
tools.description: Raw pipeline logs (transcriber/LLM/synthesizer) for a call.

tools.name: list_batch_executions
tools.description: Every call execution within a batch. Paginated.

tools.name: create_batch
tools.description: Create a batch of outbound calls from a list of recipients.

tools.name: get_batch
tools.description: A batch's status, schedule, and contact counts.

tools.name: list_batches
tools.description: Call batches for one agent.

tools.name: schedule_batch
tools.description: Schedule a batch to start calling. Spends account balance.

tools.name: stop_batch
tools.description: Halt a running or queued batch.

tools.name: delete_batch
tools.description: Permanently delete a batch.

tools.name: list_dispositions
tools.description: List dispositions, optionally scoped to an agent.

tools.name: get_disposition
tools.description: Retrieve a single disposition.

tools.name: create_disposition
tools.description: Create a disposition linked to an agent.

tools.name: bulk_create_dispositions
tools.description: Atomically create multiple dispositions for one agent.

tools.name: update_disposition
tools.description: Update a disposition (may fork a private copy).

tools.name: delete_disposition
tools.description: Permanently delete a disposition.

tools.name: test_dispositions
tools.description: Run an agent's dispositions against a sample transcript.

tools.name: list_phone_numbers
tools.description: Phone numbers on the account.

tools.name: search_phone_numbers
tools.description: Search phone numbers available for purchase.

tools.name: buy_phone_number
tools.description: Purchase a phone number. Real recurring charge.

tools.name: delete_phone_number
tools.description: Remove a phone number and stop its billing.

tools.name: setup_inbound_agent
tools.description: Route inbound calls on a number to an agent, optionally with an IVR menu.

tools.name: unlink_inbound_agent
tools.description: Remove inbound routing from a number.

tools.name: create_sip_trunk
tools.description: Create a SIP trunk with gateway and auth config.

tools.name: get_sip_trunk
tools.description: Full details of a SIP trunk.

tools.name: list_sip_trunks
tools.description: All SIP trunks on the account.

tools.name: update_sip_trunk
tools.description: Partially update a SIP trunk.

tools.name: delete_sip_trunk
tools.description: Permanently delete a trunk and its gateways/numbers.

tools.name: add_trunk_number
tools.description: Add a DID phone number to a trunk.

tools.name: remove_trunk_number
tools.description: Remove a number from a trunk.

tools.name: list_trunk_numbers
tools.description: Numbers assigned to a trunk.

tools.name: create_sub_account
tools.description: Create an isolated sub-account workspace. Requires org admin access.

tools.name: list_sub_accounts
tools.description: All sub-accounts in the organization.

tools.name: update_sub_account
tools.description: Update a sub-account's name or concurrency limits.

tools.name: delete_sub_account
tools.description: Permanently delete a sub-account and all its data.

tools.name: get_sub_account_usage
tools.description: Usage and cost breakdown for one sub-account.

tools.name: get_all_sub_accounts_usage
tools.description: Usage and cost breakdown for every sub-account.

tools.name: list_tts_providers
tools.description: TTS providers and models Bolna supports.

tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: Voices available for a TTS provider/model.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Third-party providers configured on the account (secrets masked).

tools.name: remove_provider
tools.description: Remove a configured provider by name.

tools.name: create_knowledgebase
tools.description: Create a knowledgebase by scraping a URL.

tools.name: get_knowledgebase
tools.description: A knowledgebase's file name, status, and settings.

tools.name: list_knowledgebases
tools.description: All knowledgebases on the account.

tools.name: delete_knowledgebase
tools.description: Permanently delete a knowledgebase.

tools.name: list_violations
tools.description: List flagged call violations, optionally filtered by status.

tools.name: get_user_info
tools.description: Account profile, wallet balance, concurrency limits.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Bolna documentation site for matching pages.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Fetch the full markdown content of a Bolna documentation page.

tools.name: create_workflow
tools.description: Create a new (empty) workflow.

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: List workflows, optionally filtered by name. Paginated.

tools.name: get_workflow
tools.description: A workflow's status plus its full draft/published version history.

tools.name: rename_workflow
tools.description: Rename a workflow.

tools.name: delete_workflow
tools.description: Permanently delete a workflow and every version.

tools.name: get_workflow_draft
tools.description: The current editable draft definition and its revision number.

tools.name: save_workflow_draft
tools.description: Overwrite the draft's node graph. Requires the current revision to avoid clobbering concurrent edits.

tools.name: validate_workflow
tools.description: Check the saved draft for errors before publishing.

tools.name: publish_workflow
tools.description: Freeze the draft as a new immutable published version.

tools.name: get_workflow_version
tools.description: Retrieve a specific published version's node graph.

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.description: Run a single contact through the latest published version. Places real calls/messages.

tools.name: list_workflow_node_types
tools.description: Every node type the engine supports, with its config parameters.

tools.name: create_workflow_campaign
tools.description: Create a campaign pinned to a workflow version.

tools.name: list_workflow_campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns, optionally filtered by workflow, status, or kind. Paginated.

tools.name: get_workflow_campaign
tools.description: A campaign's status and totals, plus entry/validation-error breakdowns.

tools.name: delete_workflow_campaign
tools.description: Delete an empty draft campaign.

tools.name: upload_workflow_campaign_entries
tools.description: Add contacts to a campaign.

tools.name: list_workflow_campaign_entries
tools.description: List a campaign's uploaded contacts. Paginated.

tools.name: get_workflow_campaign_entries_template
tools.description: The CSV header row the campaign's pinned version expects.

tools.name: start_workflow_campaign
tools.description: Start dispatching a campaign's pending entries. Spends account balance.

tools.name: pause_workflow_campaign
tools.description: Pause a running campaign's dispatching.

tools.name: resume_workflow_campaign
tools.description: Resume a paused campaign.

tools.name: abort_workflow_campaign
tools.description: Permanently terminate a campaign. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_workflow_campaign_executions
tools.description: List a campaign's per-contact executions. Paginated.

tools.name: get_workflow_campaign_report
tools.description: Aggregated execution/termination/per-node funnel counts.

tools.name: get_workflow_execution
tools.description: Current node, node-by-node history, and recent timeline events.

tools.name: cancel_workflow_execution
tools.description: Terminate a running execution.
